scope: Bounded literature search for the ten Hurricane candidates displayed in progress/progress.json, screening round 4, at the start of this audit. This is a record of what this search located and inspected, not an exhaustive literature review or proof of novelty. No external messages were sent.
method: Exact formulas, conventional element orderings, selected element-separated variants and candidate IDs were queried in public web search. Candidate structure links and promising publisher, author or institutional copies were opened where available. Unrelated stoichiometries, molecular clusters, hydrides, doped materials and thin-film results were not silently treated as tests of a JARVIS bulk structure. Search-index metadata and access failures are explicitly labelled.

interpretation.reported-nonsuperconducting: An inspected original research paper explicitly characterizes the material as nonsuperconducting or reports no transition under the stated conditions. This does not establish absence in every phase or at every pressure.
interpretation.measured-no-transition: A source explicitly reports a measurement with no transition in a defined range; no such new classification was assigned solely from an unrelated measurement or an abstract omitting superconductivity.
interpretation.structure-only: Structural or bibliographic evidence was located, but this audit did not establish a superconductivity measurement for the exact candidate structure.
interpretation.needs-full-text: A relevant lead exists, but the inspected material or accessible text is insufficient for the proposed physical conclusion.
interpretation.not-found-in-this-search: This bounded search did not locate an exact, usable experimental superconductivity report. This is an unknown result, not a statement that the material does not exist, was never measured or cannot superconduct.
